summary: Full regression for owner-requested batch: (1) admin DELETE /api/admin/orders/{id} endpoint + UI, (2) phone number removal, (3) event time 22:00–05:00, (4) FAQ language cleanup (no 'classic DUPLEX'/'klasický DUPLEX'), (5) legal identity (NGUYEN TRUONG AN / Benkova 177/6, Chodov, Praha 11 / IČO 22156879 / hello@asiatakeover.com / asiatakeover.com), (6) new VIP perk list without cloakroom + balloon 🎈, (7) Hero CTA 'GET TICKETS' mobile fit, (8) tickets details removed venue line and 20:00. Backend pytest: 12/12 pass (test_promo.py 8/8 regression + test_admin_delete_order.py 4/4 new). Frontend Playwright covers /faq (EN+CZ), /terms, /privacy, /contact, /tickets, / on 390px mobile viewport, and full admin UI delete flow (create order via public API → login admin → Orders tab → click delete-order-{prefix} → accept confirm → order disappears with success toast).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_delete_order (server.py:1085) correctly deletes order + tickets + sim_payments in the right sequence and logs the admin email — good audit trail.
Endpoint returns 404 on double-delete and 401/403 without auth — verified.
Ticket invalidation after delete verified: scan/lookup returns result='invalid' for previously issued codes (works because find_ticket returns None once tickets are deleted).
Admin.js:76 uses window.confirm — matches spec; delete button testid pattern is delete-order-{first-8-chars-of-id} as documented.
Hero.js:102 renders 'Get Tickets' via CSS uppercase (renders as 'GET TICKETS'); measured 180×54px on 390px viewport — single line, no wrap.
Tickets.js:346–378 hard-codes exactly the 4 standard perks and 7 VIP perks per spec; balloon emoji 🎈 present.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@asiatakeover.eu / Takeover2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Lockdown bypass via localStorage atf_unlocked=1 + atf_unlocked_at=Date.now().
seed_data_creation: Test used public POST /api/orders/create with promo_code ATFTEST95 to create disposable order; deleted via new admin endpoint in the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delete order testid pattern: [data-testid="delete-order-{first8chars}"]. Admin login form uses standard email/password inputs and a 'Sign in' button. Confirm dialog is native window.confirm — use page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()). After deletion Admin shows green toast 'Order deleted (N tickets removed)'. All content strings for phone/20:00/cloakroom/classic-DUPLEX confirmed absent site-wide.
rca of the issue: N/A — all owner-requested changes implemented correctly and verified.
